global_summary: This video is a CBS Atlanta news report covering a serious train collision with a red car at the railroad crossing intersection of East Broad Street and Mozley Street in Douglasville, Georgia. The report includes aerial footage showing the aftermath with the crushed vehicle wedged under the train's locomotive, live on-site reporting by reporter Steve Kiggins at night, witness interviews including local resident Robert Woods, and coverage of emergency responders and tow truck crews on scene. Additional segments cover general railroad crossing safety, traffic signal issues at Atlanta rail crossings, and daytime traffic activity at similar intersections. The overall content provides comprehensive local news coverage of the incident along with related transportation infrastructure footage.
